response.original_title: [{Problem_Guide}] How can you escalate a problem with an Star of the Sea  Cruise?
response.overview: To escalate an issue with Star of the Sea  Cruise line, ☏ +1-866-259-1002 {US}or +44-120-420-8151 (UK) first attempt to resolve it onboard via Guest Services or a senior officer.☏ +1-866-259-1002 {US}or +44-120-420-8151 (UK)  If unresolved, call Post-Cruise Guest Relations at ☏ +1-866-259-1002 {US}or +44-120-420-8151 (UK), email hollandguestrelations@rccl.com, or fill out the post-cruise survey. For major concerns, send a formal complaint to their Miami corporate headquarters. Escalation. Escalation Procedures: Onboard (Immediate): Report issues directly to Guest Services or request a manager. Post-Cruise (Formal):Phone: Call Guest Relations at ☏ +{1}-866-259-1002 {US} .Email: Use the online contact form for written, detailed complaints. ☏ +1-866-259-1002 {US}or +44-120-420-8151 (UK) Social Media: Engage via Twitter/X or Facebook for higher visibility. Travel Agent: If you booked through one, they can handle the escalation.
